title: Positive common-rotation averages admit an exact balanced-product Holder optimizer

statement.quantifiers: Every even N=2n, every conjugation-invariant probability measure mu on SU(2), every pure qubit product; in particular every fixed t>=0.
statement.assertion: |integral prod_i<r_i|U|r_i>dmu|<=integral|<up|U|up>|^(2n)dmu, attained by n up/n down on one axis. For e^-tJ², max_FULLSEP=sum_j m_Nj e^-tj(j+1)/binom(2n,n); t→infinity gives 1/(n+1).
assumptions: Qubit pure states form a single SU(2) orbit; N even.
Measure is positive, normalized and conjugation invariant; both SU(2) diagonal entries are conjugates.
Full collective spin projectors include multiplicities.

inputs: Positive common-rotation measure or an operator-norm approximation by positive convolution measures.
outputs: Exact full-separable expectation optimizer and explicit balanced spin weights.
interface.precision: Fixed finite N; exact limit in operator norm. No finite-L error uniform in growing N is provided.
costs: Collective Casimir/Schur readout is a global measurement; this lemma does not supply an N-party local experiment.
Continuous rotation averages, approximation and precision must be charged when used as algorithms.

proof_mechanism: Triangle inequality then Holder with all exponents N.
Conjugation invariance makes each single-state L^N norm identical.
Balanced up/down diagonal amplitudes pair as conjugates, saturating pointwise.
L independent uniform-axis rotations of angle sqrt(6t/L) give I-tJ²/L+O_N(L^-2); positive convolution powers converge to heat.
Permutation transitivity on zero magnetization strings gives sector probability m_Nj/binom(2n,n).
obstructions: A central positive operator need not have a positive group-measure representation.
No odd-N, higher-dimension or signed-kernel optimizer follows automatically.
Conditioning on the global heat effect need not preserve laboratory separability across copies.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Acquire a positive invariant group average and a realizable pointwise conjugate-balanced optimizer; check representation, precision and local/global measurement contracts separately.

review.source_reported: Source single-agent derivation and finite checks reported; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
